recommendation: Keep the no-change audit commit as-is. No additional core source work is needed for FHIR-17214; related FHIR-19280 has already been audited separately on the combined branch.
issue_request: FHIR-17214 was a Published/Persuasive FHIR-I change request for STU3 asking the specification to explicitly allow normative content to be marked deprecated or withdrawn, define what those labels mean, require guidance for avoiding deprecated material, allow ballot to withdrawn after two years, forbid future use of labels associated with withdrawn material, and permit removal of a deprecated marking by later ballot.
initial_application: The request was applied by historical git-svn commit c3d921f0f7 (svn revision 14494), which added the "Deprecation / Withdrawal of Normative Content" section to source/versions.html with the requested definitions and process rules. Later history retained that section and FHIR-17589 used it to list OperationOutcome.issue.location as deprecated.
additional_context: source/hierarchy.xml includes versions.html as the Change Management and Versioning page, so the checked source is in current build scope. FHIR-19280 later corrected the Standards Status table's Deprecated description and is already represented on the combined branch by 0c44d026f378e76b26dad78aa1badec17e958916. Community searches found no direct FHIR-17214 Confluence reference and no substantive Zulip discussion beyond the commit bot announcement.
reconciliation: No source change was made. The current source already defines Deprecated and Withdrawn for normative content, states that deprecated materials should include avoidance guidance, gives the two-year ballot path to withdrawn, prohibits reuse of computable labels from withdrawn materials, and permits later ballot removal of deprecated markings while forbidding withdrawal reversal.

related_jiras.note: Corrected the Deprecated standards-status description that was originally copied from Informative; already represented on the combined branch.
Later used the deprecation process by listing OperationOutcome.issue.location as deprecated in source/versions.html.
